reason: E2 supports the premise that Cu has low cohesive energy and segregates to surfaces, but it concerns a different HEA (PdCuPtNiCo) and relies on simulations, not direct observation in Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu. E1 shows homogeneous mixing in Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu nanoparticles with only slight Cr segregation, which does not support the claimed Cu segregation or its effect on melting. The link between segregation and premelting onset is not directly evidenced by either passage.
